findings.title: Prepublication receipt is flushed to stdout but is not durably persisted by this implementation
findings.evidence: Owned fresh-plan prints one pending-plan-publication JSON line with flush=true before _atomic_create_plan links the plan. There is no receipt path, append-only JSONL store, fsync of a receipt file, or caller acknowledgement before plan publication. Tests intercept print or use StringIO; they do not run an independent supervisor that durably stores the receipt and confirms persistence before the plan link. The audit explicitly says an external supervisor must persist this receipt and that this change does not implement that service.
findings.impact: If stdout is a pipe/terminal and the caller loses the line before persisting its commitment SHA, recovery intentionally fails closed. Therefore the requested durable-receipt-before-publication property is not established end to end; an immutable commitment alone is not an externally pinned trust anchor.
findings.recommendation: Keep plan creation/stage 4 blocked until the receipt persistence boundary is implemented or a concrete external supervisor is independently exercised. Require durable append/fsync and acknowledgement of the exact pending receipt before _atomic_create_plan can publish; retain failure-injection coverage for supervisor interruption and receipt persistence failure. Do not infer durability from print(flush=True).

scope_limits: The caller-pinned commitment and recovery validation are sound at the source boundary, subject to the missing durable receipt acknowledgement above.
No claim that fresh-run initialization, run verification, advance, ordinal guards, ordinary phase, end-to-end receipt lifecycle, or product acceptance is complete.
No Termrock application architecture or visual parity review was performed in this task.
